subject.title: feat(runner): support OpenClaw plugins across the ClawHub profile

question: Should the public ClawScan CLI adopt OpenClaw plugins as a first-class target and artifact contract, rather than keeping the product skill-focused or confining plugin parity to separate tooling?
rationale: The implementation is technically substantial and useful, but it expands the public target model and scanner-adapter contract beyond the current skill-oriented CLI boundary, which repository policy leaves to owner judgment.

options.title: Approve first-class plugins
options.body: Approve the public plugin target and artifact contract after the branch accepts OpenClaw-compatible bounded JSON5 manifests.

options.title: Keep the CLI skill-focused
options.body: Decline the new public target kind and move any ClawHub plugin parity workflow into separate maintainer tooling.

options.title: Narrow the contract
options.body: Allow explicit plugin scanning without promising broad artifact or adapter API stability until a smaller contract is designed.

recommendation.title: Approve first-class plugins
recommendation.body: Approve the public plugin target and artifact contract after the branch accepts OpenClaw-compatible bounded JSON5 manifests.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the requested code owner and the strongest available history match for the ClawHub runner and release surface.
